# Agent Trust Scan

> Security reviews for AI agents with wallets. Free 10-point scan in 48 hours.

## What it is

A static scanner plus a human review for agents that can move money. It checks:
private keys and API tokens in files, `.env` in the tree, unlimited token approvals,
x402 testnet/disabled/price-below-cost/no-receipt, missing spend limits, kill switch,
human approval, audit log, and eval/exec/pickle/shell on tool output.

The scanner is open source: https://github.com/mrpkk/agent-trust-scan

## Services

- Free Agent Wallet Scan — 0 USD, 48 hours, 2-page report.
- Agent Wallet Security Review — 2,500 USD, threat model, live prompt-injection tests,
  wallet permissions, limits, kill switch, x402 flow, report and retest.
- Payable Agent Sprint — 3,500 USD, USDC/x402 pay-per-call, cost-based pricing,
  receipt check, docs, deploy on client infrastructure.
- Payable + Safe — 5,500 USD, both plus 30 days of support.
- Trust Retainer — 1,500 USD/month, monitoring, policy updates, monthly report,
  incident response.
- Small Contract Review — from 2,000 USD.

Payment in USDC on Base or Solana. The client keeps custody; we do not hold funds
or process payments for third parties.

## Request a scan

https://github.com/mrpkk/agent-trust-scan/issues/new?template=scan-request.yml

Do not paste private keys, seed phrases, or customer data.

## Limits

Static scan is heuristic; it does not execute the agent or prove exploitability.
A paid review adds live tests and a threat model. It is not a guarantee.
